svg.text: Activity: send money to a friend (P2P)
One database transaction moves the money. The Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same result instead of paying twice.
Pick a friend, type amount and
wallets in id order, post journal
Same rules for wallet-to-wallet inside NovaWallet: no
fee in the pilot, daily limit by KYC tier, receiver must
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
